scope: P3 strategy preparation: proposed contracts and development assertions only. These specifications do not establish current runtime support, physiological thresholds, reviewed prescriptions, or comparative coaching quality.
relationshipNotes: p3-dev-08 and p3-dev-09 are deliberately paired counterfactual arrangements and must remain in the same evaluation split.
Fixed quantities and time estimates are synthetic input facts. Expected assertions check preservation and feasibility, not the coaching suitability of those numbers.
